sources.title: Dynamical zeta functions for maps of the interval
sources.inspected_scope: Entire three-page research announcement; interval transfer definition, generating partition theorem and representative periodic-point modification.
sources.role_and_boundary: Its actual transfer operator sums preimages; its zeta sums fixed points. Not a theorem identifying first returns to a section with closed orbits.
